title: Testing PHP Applications
summary: Automated PHP tests guard auth, SQL, and API regressions — run on your computer, not in DevPath.
objectives: Explain Testing PHP Applications in practical web-development terms
Recognize how PHP connects to HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Apply safe habits and avoid common mistakes

content.md: Use isolated databases or transactions rolled back after tests. Never point tests at production data.

quickRecap: Practice with the quiz — execution on device is limited to HTML/CSS/JS in the playground.

exercise.prompt: Review the example, then open the playground only when the lesson uses HTML/CSS/JS starter code. Complete the quiz to earn XP.
